text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The annual summer training camp has officially kicked off!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dia-chan, do you have a second?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: What is it?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Um... What you said back during the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: To think that everyone "expects great things" from me...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"In my own way,
I've been thinking about what kind of 'expectations' people have for me."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: And so... I've decided!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
If everyone sees themselves in my struggle,
then I'll keep showing them a run that never gives up!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I know everyone's counting on me to crawl
right back up from rock bottom with everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Never giving up and toughing it out with sheer guts—
that's who I am, after all!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu!
That's our Kita-chan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
So with that, my goal is to win the Tenno Sho (Autumn),
the Japan Cup, and the Arima Kinen—all three of 'em!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
So I'm going to beat Teio-san
and McQueen-san both!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I've admired her for so long, so I know how strong she is, and I know just how hard it is to beat her...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that's precisely why I want to win!!
I want to surpass the one I look up to!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"To make up for letting everyone down at the Takarazuka Kinen,
I want to show them a me that surpasses my inspirations!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...I feel the same way.
I want to surpass the one I look up to, too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I won't give up victory, not even to Kita-chan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!! Let's both do our best!
See you later then!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, thank goodness...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right. Trainer,
I have a favor to ask...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: "Regarding our future direction. I want to build more power so that I can handle a wider variety of situations."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: "The other day, I was watching McQueen-san's races for research purposes, and..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Powerful leg strength that completely ignores the heavy track.
The sheer force with which she dug into the ground was truly memorable."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
If only I had that kind of power too...
I thought it would be so effective for breaking out of dense packs.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...No, reinforcing the areas I currently lack is essential if I want to beat McQueen-san and the others, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"This is an opportunity that McQueen-san and the others
went out of their way to prepare for me.
I want to go into it in top condition and win...!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Furthermore, as a distinguished Umamusume,
I also hope to eventually take on the challenge
of racing overseas."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I remember talk coming up at the New Year's party
about an overseas expedition someday.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There is no doubt that conquering tough overseas turf
requires immense power.
choice_data_list: Why did you set your sights abroad?
Why did you set your sights abroad?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I haven't fully decided yet, but...
the other day, we spoke about what my running could bring to everyone, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
When Trainer mentioned 'possibility,'
it finally clicked for me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Victory in a prestigious race steeped in French tradition—
a feat that has continued to elude Japan's Umamusume racing world...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Having overcome the Satono jinx, I hope everyone
can see the potential in me to weave a brand-new history.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: "In that case, I thought it best to start keeping international races in mind from now on."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she builds more power,
it's certain her adaptability will increase just as she said.
There's no particular reason to refuse.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry for troubling you.
I leave it in your capable hands.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
A new running style filled with power...
I must master it without fail!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Otherwise, I won't be able to look
McQueen-san in the eye!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having faced the one she looked up to and gained a clear direction toward her goal,
Satono Diamond was brimming with motivation.
